model_family: WMH31017H 1.7 cu. ft. Microwave Hood Combination with Electronic Touch Controls
sticker_location: Open the door and look on the front face of the microwave opening, behind the door. The model and serial sticker is there.

parts.label: grease filters
parts.where: Two flat metal screens on the underside of the microwave, above the cooktop.

parts.label: charcoal filter
parts.where: Hidden behind the vent grille at the top front of the microwave.

parts.label: vent grille
parts.where: The long strip across the top front of the microwave, above the door.

parts.label: round glass turntable plate
parts.where: The round glass plate sitting in the middle inside the microwave.

parts.label: turntable support ring with wheels
parts.where: The ring with small wheels under the round glass plate inside.

parts.label: inside of the microwave
parts.where: The walls, floor and ceiling of the box where food goes.

parts.label: flat cover on the inside wall
parts.where: The flat panel on the inside wall of the microwave. Clean it gently, do not remove it.

parts.label: microwave door
parts.where: The large door on the front that opens to put food in.

parts.label: door seal area
parts.where: The edge of the door and the frame it touches when the door closes.

parts.label: touch control panel
parts.where: The flat button panel to the right of the door on the front.

parts.label: cooktop light cover
parts.where: The small cover on the underside of the microwave, above the cooktop.

parts.label: cooktop light bulb
parts.where: Under the small cover on the underside of the microwave.

parts.label: inside light bulb cover
parts.where: Behind the vent grille at the top front, over the inside light bulb.

parts.label: inside light bulb
parts.where: Behind the vent grille at the top front of the microwave.

parts.label: power cord and plug
parts.where: The cord from the top of the microwave, usually plugged in inside the cabinet above it.

symptoms: It won't start at all
I press Start and nothing happens
The screen says door
Buttons beep but it won't cook

plan.diagnosis: The door may not be fully closed, or the controls may be locked. A power problem can also stop it starting.
safety: Do not use the microwave if the door is bent or does not close properly.
Do not open the back or inside panels of the microwave.
If water does not heat after these checks, stop and call for service.

steps.check: The door is shut flat with no gaps.
details: Push until you hear it click.
Remove any spacer stuck inside the door.
steps.instruction: Firmly close the microwave door until it clicks

steps.check: The door has been opened and shut again.
details: This clears a door message on the screen.
The message appears after the door sits closed too long.
steps.instruction: Open and close the door once again

steps.check: The small padlock picture is gone from the screen.
details: Hold Cancel for about 3 seconds.
Wait for two beeps.
steps.instruction: Hold Cancel for three seconds to unlock controls

steps.check: The plug feels tight and cannot wiggle loose.
details: Look in the cabinet above the microwave.
Also check your home breaker has not tripped.
steps.instruction: Check the plug sits tight in its outlet

steps.check: The water feels warm after two minutes.
details: Use a microwave-safe cup with 1 cup cold water.
If it stays cold, call for service.
steps.instruction: Press Start and heat cup of water

symptoms: I see sparks inside
There are blue flashes when it cooks
It crackles and flashes with some dishes

plan.diagnosis: Sparks are often caused by metal in the microwave or baked-on food splashes. Cleaning the inside and removing metal usually stops it.
safety: Stop the microwave right away if you see sparks.
Do not put metal, foil liners, twist ties or gold-trim dishes inside.
If sparking continues after cleaning, stop using it and call for service.

steps.check: The microwave has stopped and the screen is clear.
details: Press Cancel once.
Leave the door closed for a moment if food flared.
steps.instruction: Press Cancel and stop the microwave now

steps.check: No fork, foil or metal dish is left inside.
details: Use oven mitts if the dish is hot.
Check for twist ties and foil wrappers too.
steps.instruction: Open door and remove any metal items

steps.check: The inside walls look clean with no baked-on splashes.
details: Use mild soap, water and a soft cloth.
Never use rough pads or metal scrapers.
Wipe the flat cover gently, do not remove it.
steps.instruction: Wipe inside walls with soft soapy cloth

steps.check: The door edge and frame look clean and smooth.
details: Wipe where the door touches the frame.
Old food here can cause sparks.
steps.instruction: Wipe the area where door meets frame

steps.check: The water heats with no sparks or flashes.
details: Use a microwave-safe cup.
Stay nearby and watch the test.
Stop at once if sparks return.
steps.instruction: Heat one cup water and watch carefully

symptoms: The fan doesn't pull smoke anymore
Cooking smells hang around the kitchen
Steam from pots isn't being cleared
The vent sounds on but does nothing

plan.diagnosis: The screens under the microwave are likely clogged with grease. The hidden charcoal filter may also be old and full.
safety: Make sure all controls are off and the microwave is cool first.
Do not keep using the fan with the filters taken out.
Unplug the microwave before removing the vent grille screws.

steps.check: The fan and lights are off and the underside feels cool.
details: Press Cancel and turn the fan off.
Wait until the cooktop below is cool too.
steps.instruction: Turn off microwave and let it cool

steps.check: Both grease filters are out in your hands.
details: They are on the underside, above the cooktop.
Slide away from the small tab, then let them drop down.
steps.instruction: Slide grease filters away from their tabs

steps.check: The filters look clean and are fully dry.
details: Use warm water with mild soap.
The manual also allows the dishwasher.
Let them dry fully before putting them back.
steps.instruction: Wash grease filters in warm soapy water

steps.check: The vent grille is off and set aside safely.
details: Remove the 2 screws on the grille.
Slide it left, tilt it forward, then lift it out.
Keep the screws in a safe cup.
steps.instruction: Unscrew and lift off the top vent grille

steps.check: The new charcoal filter sits flat in its hooks.
details: The old one cannot be washed, replace it about every 6 months.
Put the wire mesh side facing the front.
steps.instruction: Swap old charcoal filter for a new one

steps.check: The grille sits flat and both screws are tight.
details: Push the bottom hooks into their holes first.
Tilt it back, slide right, then add screws.
steps.instruction: Put vent grille back and tighten both screws

steps.check: Both filters sit flat and do not wobble.
details: Push one end into the opening opposite the tab.
Swing up and slide toward the tab.
steps.instruction: Slide clean grease filters back until seated

symptoms: The light over my stove went out
I press Light and nothing happens
The cooktop underneath is dark

plan.diagnosis: The small bulb under the microwave has probably burned out. It is made to be changed at home.
safety: Unplug the microwave or turn its breaker off before changing the bulb.
Let the old bulb cool before touching it.
Use only the bulb type your manual asks for, not an LED unless the manual says so.

steps.check: The microwave screen is dark and will not turn on.
details: Unplug it, or switch its breaker off.
The plug is usually in the cabinet above.
steps.instruction: Unplug microwave or turn its breaker off

steps.check: You can see the small cover above the cooktop.
details: Look on the underside of the microwave.
It is held by small screws.
steps.instruction: Find light cover on underside of microwave

steps.check: The cover is open and you can see the bulb.
details: Keep the screw in a safe cup.
Open the cover gently, do not force it.
steps.instruction: Remove cover screw and open light cover

steps.check: The old bulb is out.
details: Twist gently, do not squeeze hard.
If stuck, stop and let it cool more.
steps.instruction: Twist out old bulb and remove it

steps.check: The new bulb sits tight and does not wobble.
details: Screw it in by hand only.
Do not overtighten it.
steps.instruction: Screw in new bulb by hand only

steps.check: The cover is closed and its screw is tight.
details: Close the cover flat first.
Then put the screw back.
steps.instruction: Replace cover and tighten its screw

steps.check: The light under the microwave comes on.
details: Plug it back in or turn the breaker on.
Press the Light button to test high and low.
steps.instruction: Plug microwave back in and test light

symptoms: It thumps and rumbles when it runs
The plate stopped turning
My mug wobbles around in circles
It makes a grinding noise

plan.diagnosis: The glass plate or the wheeled ring under it is likely dirty or sitting crooked. Cleaning and reseating them usually fixes the noise.
safety: Let the plate cool before lifting it out.
Do not run the microwave without the glass plate in place.
Use a microwave-safe cup for the water test.

steps.check: The glass plate is out on a soft towel.
details: Lift it straight up with both hands.
It can be slippery, go slowly.
steps.instruction: Remove round glass plate from inside microwave

steps.check: The plate and wheeled ring look clean.
details: Wash with mild soap and water.
The plate can also go in the dishwasher.
Dry both pieces fully.
steps.instruction: Lift out support ring and wash both pieces

steps.check: The floor inside looks clean and dry.
details: Crumbs under the wheels cause thumping.
Use a soft cloth, not a rough pad.
steps.instruction: Wipe crumbs from floor under the plate

steps.check: The ring sits flat and rolls smoothly by hand.
details: Line it up in the groove in the floor.
Give it a gentle spin to check.
steps.instruction: Set support ring flat in its center groove

steps.check: The plate sits flat and does not rock.
details: Lower it onto the center and the ring.
Turn it a little until it settles down.
steps.instruction: Set glass plate onto its center post

steps.check: The plate turns smoothly with no thumping sound.
details: Use 1 cup of water in a microwave-safe cup.
Run it for one minute and listen.
steps.instruction: Heat cup of water and listen closely

symptoms: The screen is flashing PF
The clock just shows a flashing colon
It won't cook since the power blinked

plan.diagnosis: A flashing colon or PF just means the power went out. The clock simply needs to be set again.
safety: This is normal after a power cut, it is not a fault code to fear.
A letter followed by a number is different, call for help with that.
Never open the microwave cabinet to look for a reset switch.

steps.check: The flashing display has cleared.
details: Press Cancel once.
This does not harm any settings.
steps.instruction: Press Cancel to clear the flashing display

steps.check: The numbers you want are showing on the screen.
details: This clock uses 12-hour time.
Type the time with the number buttons.
steps.instruction: Press Clock and enter correct time

steps.check: The clock stops flashing and shows the time steadily.
details: Press Clock or Start to save it.
The microwave should now cook normally.
steps.instruction: Press Clock again to save the time

symptoms: It's dark inside when I open the door
The inside light stopped coming on
I can't see my food cooking

plan.diagnosis: The bulb that lights the inside has probably burned out. It hides behind the top front grille and can be changed at home.
safety: Unplug the microwave or turn its breaker off before removing the grille.
Let the old bulb cool before touching it.
Use only the bulb type your manual asks for.

steps.check: The microwave screen is dark and will not turn on.
details: Unplug it, or switch its breaker off.
The plug is usually in the cabinet above.
steps.instruction: Unplug microwave or turn its breaker off

steps.check: Both grille screws are safe in a cup.
details: The grille is the strip above the door.
You only need to loosen its 2 screws.
steps.instruction: Remove two screws from top vent grille

steps.check: The grille is off and set aside safely.
details: Slide it left first.
Then tilt forward and lift it out.
steps.instruction: Slide grille left, tilt and lift it out

steps.check: You can see the small bulb under its cover.
details: Open the cover gently.
Do not pull on any wires.
steps.instruction: Open inside light cover behind grille

steps.check: The new bulb sits tight and does not wobble.
details: Twist the old one out gently.
Screw the new one in by hand only.
steps.instruction: Twist out old bulb, screw in new one

steps.check: The grille sits flat and both screws are tight.
details: Push the bottom hooks into their holes.
Tilt back, slide right, close the bulb cover, add screws.
Plug back in and open the door to test.
steps.instruction: Put vent grille back and tighten screws
